gizmo.title: Kaipūrei tuhinga
gizmo.description: He aratohu, he whakaaturanga me te tohutoro mō tētahi wāhanga tukutuku, me ngā pātene tārua mō te HTML, te kawemai, npm me CDN.

configure.title: Kōnae raraunga tuhinga
configure.description: Ngā raraunga tuhinga ka tukuna me te huānga (lib/tag.docs.json).

configure.title: Papa kōrero aratohu
configure.description: Te papa kōrero nekehanga ka tukuna me te huānga (tag.motion.json). Kōwhiringa.

configure.title: Akoranga ataata
configure.description: He ataata poto mō te huānga (YouTube, Vimeo, he kōnae ataata rānei). Ka whakakapi i te ataata i ngā raraunga tuhinga.

configure.title: Whakatuwhera ki te ripa
configure.description: Ko tēhea ripa ka whakaaturia tuatahi.

configure.title: Pūrei aunoa i te aratohu
configure.description: Tīmatahia te aratohu ina puta te kaipūrei. Ka wareware mēnā he pai ake ki te kaipānui te nekehanga iti.

advanced.title: Kaupapa aratohu
advanced.description: Mō ngā huānga he maha ō rātou aratohu, ko tēhea kaupapa hei whakatuwhera tuatahi (hei tauira add-blocks). Waiho kia wātea mō te mea matua.

advanced.title: Hono whakaaturanga ora
advanced.description: Te wāhi e haere ai te pātene “Whakatuwhera pūtake whakaaturanga”. Ko te taunoa ko te kōpaki whakaaturanga i te pūtahi.

advanced.title: Hono tuhinga
advanced.description: Te wāhi e haere ai te pātene tuhinga katoa, hei tauira te whārangi Learn HAX e hāngai ana.
